summary: End-to-end verification of new features on IQ Aptitude MCP server. 31/31 backend pytest cases pass (11 existing + 20 new covering OAuth 2.1 discovery/register/PKCE-authorize/token/refresh/invalid_grant, MCP dual-auth (static + OAuth Bearer), non-blocking /rest/upload (~<1s) and /rest/reindex, /rest/ingest-status, sources-ready with Noor imagePages=66, /rest/file/{id} open + download + 404, path-traversal blocked, Arabic-first questionText with Western digits only, quiz Arabic + no correctAnswer, check_answer Arabic explanation). Frontend dashboard shows stats (3 sources, 12 questions, 63 passages), all 3 sources 'ready', language tags on each row, and Open/Download/Re-index/Delete testids per source.
critical_code_review_comments: MCP SSE responses contain unescaped characters that Python's str.splitlines() treats as line terminators (likely U+2028/U+000B/etc inside Arabic strings). Not a functional bug (the JSON is valid), but any strict SSE parser using splitlines will break. Consider forcing escape of these codepoints in the emitted JSON string (JSON.stringify with a replacer that escapes \u2028\u2029\u000b\u000c) or emitting only ASCII (ensure_ascii equivalent). Test scaffolding was updated to split on \n only + force UTF-8 decode.
MCP /mcp responses do not set Content-Type charset=utf-8 explicitly (requests default to latin-1 decode of body). Recommend setting Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8.

/rest/file/..%2f... is blocked at Cloudflare edge with HTTP 400 (before reaching Express). This is fine for prod, but note that path-traversal safety of resolveSourceFile could not be exercised through the preview URL directly. Recommend adding a unit test in /app/tests exercising resolveSourceFile with traversal inputs.
test_credentials: Static MCP: iq-mcp-local-dev-token-9f3a2b7c ; OAuth via dynamic registration + PKCE S256.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a tiny valid PDF as TEST_upload.pdf via /rest/upload (indexed to 'ready').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files under /app/backend/tests. Run serially with `pytest -n 0` because reindex/upload background work is server-global. parse_sse must split on '\n' only (not str.splitlines()) and decode response body as UTF-8 (r.content.decode('utf-8')) because server does not declare charset and Arabic content contains bytes Python interprets as extra line separators. OAuth flow: POST /oauth/register -> GET /oauth/authorize (auto-approves, no login) -> POST /oauth/token grant_type=authorization_code with PKCE verifier -> refresh_token. Access tokens are HS256 JWT accepted at /mcp alongside static MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.
